description: Cap of the Scarlet Savant Level 60 In order to create the Cap of the Scarlet Savant, you will be required to bring the following items back to Malyfous Darkhammer: 1 Pristine Hide of the Beast; 5 Frayed Abomination Stitchings; 8 Arcane Crystals; 5 Enchanted Scarlet Thread. You will also be required to pay 50 gold pieces for the crafting of the item. Requirements: - Frayed Abomination Stitching x 5 - Arcane Crystal x 8 - Enchanted Scarlet Thread x 5 - Money: 50
name: Cap of the Scarlet Savant
